candidates.reason: A proper vertical reflow with a clear order: logo, headline, body, product, CTA. Flaws: the body copy sits tight under the headline. The CTA, sub-line and legal are packed into the bottom 20% of the canvas. The decorative bottom-right circle crowds the legal text near the edge, and the box hangs off the left of its circle.

The square layout is just shrunk into the middle of the tall canvas, leaving big empty bands top and bottom. The logo wordmark, sub-line and legal are too small to read, and the CTA is tiny. Nothing was rearranged for the format.

The big three-line headline and centred product work well. But the bottom splits into cramped columns. The narrow body copy wraps badly into five ragged lines, and the 'Now in 4-packs' line is bigger than the CTA label, so the button loses prominence. The top-right decorative circle feels randomly placed.

Same structure as candidate 3, with the same weak bottom columns: the body breaks awkwardly ('wild honey' alone on a line) and 'Now in 4-packs' outweighs the CTA. On top of that, the decorative circle collides with the legal text in the bottom-right corner, and the legal is jammed against the bottom edge.
